quests.title: Captain Stan - Mermaid Palace Stickers
quests.prereqText: Level 80+, have completed Skipper Min - Min's Weakness
steps: Talk to Captain Stan at Gate of Mermaid Palace.

Get 7x Palace Proof Sticker: Mermaid Palace sticker quests: Genius Cochma - Mermaid Palace Survey 4, La Vida - Treasure Map 1/2, Prince Sebastian - Prince the Merman 2, Frog Shaman - Magic Ingredient 4, Fairy Asrai - Make a Merperson Potion, Mermaid Marin - Marin's Worry, Sea Spirit Rumo - Ride a Fish / Okto's Staff, Lethos - Beauty Secrets 4, Guard Gilbert - Better Weapons.
Get 1x Old Picture: Drilled in Mermaid Palace Fields.
Bring everything back to Captain Stan.

source.from: Mermaid Palace sticker quests: Genius Cochma - Mermaid Palace Survey 4, La Vida - Treasure Map 1/2, Prince Sebastian - Prince the Merman 2, Frog Shaman - Magic Ingredient 4, Fairy Asrai - Make a Merperson Potion, Mermaid Marin - Marin's Worry, Sea Spirit Rumo - Ride a Fish / Okto's Staff, Lethos - Beauty Secrets 4, Guard Gilbert - Better Weapons
Drilled in Mermaid Palace Fields (drill depth not on the wiki)

quests.notes: Palace Proof Sticker comes from that area's sticker quests (see the source on the item). Old Picture is drilled in Mermaid Palace Fields.

quests.title: Captain Stan - Captain's Stan Past
quests.prereqText: Level 80+, have completed Mermaid Palace Stickers
steps: Talk to Captain Stan at Gate of Mermaid Palace.
Get 1x Tanya's Letter: reward from Mermaid Marin - Marin's Sister.
Bring everything back to Captain Stan.

source.from: Reward from Mermaid Marin - Marin's Sister

quests.notes: Tanya's Letter is obtained by completing Mermaid Marin - Marin's Sister.

quests.title: Mermaid Marin - Marin's Sister
quests.prereqText: Level 80+, have Captain's Stan Past in quest log
steps: Talk to Mermaid Marin at Mermaid Palace Field 4 - Rock Square.
Get 1x Adventurer's Book: reward from Skipper Min - Min's Weakness.
Get 1x Tanya's Sword: dropped by Tanya (Lv.150) in Mermaid Dungeon 2 - Legend of the Sea.
Bring everything back to Mermaid Marin.

source.from: Reward from Skipper Min - Min's Weakness

source.map: Mermaid Dungeon 2 - Legend of the Sea

quests.notes: To iniate the quest, bring her Tanya's Sword and show it to her. Tanya's Sword is dropped by Tanya (Lv.150). Adventurer's Book is obtained by completing Min's Weakness.
